meta.name: react-best-practices
meta.description: React and Next.js performance optimization from Vercel Engineering. Use when building React components, optimizing performance, eliminating waterfalls, reducing bundle size, reviewing code for performance issues, or implementing server/client-side optimizations.

copy.tagline: 优化React与Next.js应用性能,减少加载时间
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是React开发者想优化应用性能
copy.tagline_en: Optimize React and Next.js app performance, cut load times
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a React developer aiming to improve app performance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Vercel 工程团队的规则帮你优化 React/Next.js 性能。它会先判断问题类型(如加载慢、包体积大、重渲染过多),只读取相关规则;然后按影响优先级给出修改建议,并附上发布前检查清单、常见错误提示和性能审计脚本。
howto.when: 当你要求构建 React 组件、优化性能、审查代码性能问题等时触发;服务端/客户端优化同样适用。

say.text: 我的页面加载很慢,帮我找出数据请求里的瀑布流并消除。
say.note: 它会读取瀑布流规则,给出并行请求等改法。

say.text: 检查这个 React 组件的打包体积,哪些依赖可以按需加载?
say.note: 它会审查导入方式,建议动态加载大依赖。

say.text: 按影响优先级审查这个项目的性能问题并给修复建议。
say.note: Claude 从最关键的问题开始逐项列出。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude acts as a React/Next.js performance expert. It identifies the problem type, reads only relevant rules, then gives fixes ordered by impact, plus a pre-ship checklist and common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build React/Next.js components, optimize performance, or review code for performance issues, among others; also used for server/client-side optimizations.

say_en.text: My page is slow; find and remove data-fetching waterfalls.
say_en.note: Claude reads waterfall rules and suggests parallel fetch.

say_en.text: Check this component's bundle size and suggest on-demand loading.
say_en.note: Reviews imports and proposes dynamic imports.

say_en.text: Audit this project's performance issues and rank fixes by impact.
say_en.note: Lists issues from critical to minor.
